original_lookup_limit: The replay explicit_missing_lookup_bindings array only enumerates missing record-form wrappers. The one selected missing intro clause is disclosed in the source lineage receipt and recovered separately; an empty array is not an exhaustive absence claim.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: The plan has a POS option for outside-network providers at additional cost; Chapter 3 Section 2.3 supplies conditions. Do not turn the HMO label into a prohibition of all OON care.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: The HMO-POS nature and Chapter 3 pointer remain scoped, with no all-OON prohibition.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Retain the network/full-cost wording, listed emergency/urgent/dialysis/authorized exceptions and the complete POS paragraph continuing onto page 9: certain services, generally higher sharing and possible other restrictions.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: The POS continuation is bound through EOC9; generic directory restrictions and exceptions are retained without imposing precedence.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: PCP oversight and recommended notification/coordination are distinct from a required PCP referral or hospital admission order.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: PCP oversight/recommended coordination remains distinct from a permission gate and from formal inpatient status.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: The explicit no-PCP-referral statement is for network specialists or behavioral/mental-health providers; do not broaden it automatically to every service or admission.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: The no-PCP-referral statement stays limited to named network specialist/behavioral/mental-health access.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: OON chart sharing applies even with referral or pre-visit decision. If no contracted provider is available, member may ask to access OON care at IN sharing; this is conditional, not a general cost conversion.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: Referral or a pre-visit decision does not itself convert OON sharing; requesting IN sharing for network unavailability is separate.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: When an IN provider or benefit is unavailable or inadequate to meet medical needs, the plan arranges medically necessary covered care OON at IN sharing. Preserve all antecedents and the plan-arranged route.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: The arrangement commitment retains the source context, medical need, covered benefit and medically necessary scope.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: OON choice requires covered benefits and medical necessity; noncontracted providers generally have no duty to treat except emergencies. Medicare participation eligibility and opted-out/excluded/precluded provider limits remain, with the emergency exception.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: Covered/necessary benefit, provider willingness and Medicare eligibility restrictions retain their separate qualifications and emergency exception.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Explicit no-referral/no-PA OON statement retains the pre-visit coverage-decision advice, possible denial/entire-cost liability for uncovered or unnecessary services, and appeal rights.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: OON no-referral/no-PA remains explicit; later coverage denial and full liability depend on the stated uncovered/unnecessary/denied route.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Preserve the 50 states/DC POS scope, no-territories statement, its complete printed parenthetical emergency/post-stabilization/dialysis/urgent exceptions and certain-services/network-only qualifications. Do not silently expand territories or worldwide routine POS.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: The 50-state/DC POS scope, territorial exclusions and complete printed exceptions are retained; territory interactions remain held.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Preserve provider-bill-plan recommendation, reimbursement after member payment and sending an unpaid bill to the plan as distinct routes; do not require advance payment for all payment requests.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: RF-NR-R1-F01: NR10 does not explicitly bind separate paid/unpaid routes to their effects. Correction required in a new revision.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Emergency care does not require initial PCP approval/referral or a network doctor; the prudent-layperson belief and harm scope, worldwide emergency route and provider determination of stabilization remain.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: Emergency access, prudent-layperson belief and worldwide initial route remain separate from provider stabilization decisions and later care.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Generic US OON follow-up higher sharing and the authorized OON inpatient after-stabilization IN-sharing exception retain their distinct scopes. Authorization AND after-stabilization must remain together; not every OON stay receives IN sharing.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: Generic US follow-up sharing and the authorized OON inpatient post-stabilization exception are retained separately; no automatic applicability resolution.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Foreign emergency coverage stays limited to immediate emergency/stabilization. Post-stabilization care beyond that must be in the US to be eligible; repatriation and preplanned foreign services exclusions remain. Preserve source wording rather than inventing coverage.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: Immediate emergency/stabilization scope, qualified foreign follow-up limitation, US eligibility statement, repatriation and planned-service exclusions remain.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Urgent service scope retains temporary out-of-area OR unreasonable given time/place/circumstances to obtain network care, routine-visit exclusion and the complete foreign continuation.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: Immediate/nonemergency AND (location OR circumstances) logic is preserved; routine visits and foreign continuation remain distinct.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Declared-disaster authorities and geographic predicate remain. OON at IN sharing requires inability to use a network provider during the disaster; it is not every ordinary OON visit.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: Declared geographic disaster and inability to use network constrain the printed OON-at-IN-sharing route; no ordinary OON election is inferred.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Retain OON-without-authorization full-cost and generic network/referral language alongside explicit POS no-referral/no-PA and Chapter 4 no-advance-approval statements. Any proposed relationship needs exact source-based applicability reasoning; a generic precedence convention alone is insufficient.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: RF-NR-R1-F02: NR15 full-cost consequence lacks an explicit exception-failure binding. The generic/POS applicability tension is correctly held separately.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: IN authorization is attached to some chart services and MAY/double-dagger scope; preserve provider responsibility, no advance OON approval, optional advance coverage decision and valid course-of-treatment duration criteria.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: MAY/marked IN services, provider responsibility, no OON advance approval, optional decision and valid-course duration remain distinct; NR18 has explicit branches.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Minimum 90-day no-PA transition applies to a new enrollee active treatment course, including a course commenced with OON provider. It is not a generic annual PA waiver for all care.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: The 90-day active-course new-enrollee transition includes courses begun OON, without creating a general recurring waiver.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Any discussion of trial no-plan/PCP-permission or network exception preserves Medicare-approved study scope, NCD-CED/IDE benefit exception and possible PA/other plan rules. No waiver is imported into ordinary inpatient care.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: Approved-study participation/network exceptions preserve NCD-CED/IDE qualifications. A supplemental payment-notice defect is recorded separately as RF-NR-R1-F03.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Formal physician admission order, discharge-day boundary and observation distinction are not referral or plan authorization. Admission/facility-type reset, transplant-network limits and nominal chart sharing remain separate.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: Formal order/observation/admission reset and transplant network remain separate from referral and PA. Legacy malformed extraction is retained, not silently repaired.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: SB nationwide Medicare-accepting provider summary and possible higher OON sharing retain certain-services limitation and EOC detail. No participation or coverage for an actual provider is established.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: SB nationwide Medicare-accepting provider choice retains for-some-services and possible higher-sharing qualifications; no actual network verification follows.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Exact flat inpatient referral question/No is a distinct source-format result. Do not decode native raw 2 or turn a physician order, generic network condition or source silence into a matching referral predicate.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: The exact flat referral answer is separate from the undecoded native string2 and from carrier terms; no universal decoder is inferred.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Bind each source rule and continuation to exact original IDs, roles, original hashes/states and precise source regions/words. Broad contextual overlap or page membership is not whole-original equivalence.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: 470 original payloads and 830 associated observation relationships replay exactly. Page-context associations are not equivalence. One selected native intro reference lacks a payload in the old export; it is recovered only by the separate additive lookup.

presealed_case_dispositions.expected_meaning: Any remaining r3 referral unknown must receive a specific disposition and remaining action. No favorable whole-original outcome, source acceptance, canonical adoption, current provider/network verification or app/database integration follows from this review.
presealed_case_dispositions.review: The r3 underbinding is explicitly identified and independently replayed. Its correction is separately verified in inpatient r4; r1 itself does not change that record or grant source acceptance.

supplemental_finding_origin.RF-NR-R1-F03: After-candidate inspection of approved-study payment branch against EOC35 notice paragraph; not a presealed expected judgment.
